_note: Direction fixes for the pets' running frames. By convention row 1 (0-based) of the sprite sheet is running-right and row 2 is running-left; a pet that deviates is listed here by pet id: "pet-id": { "right": "row", "left": "row" }, where the value is "row" or "rowm" (m = mirror horizontally). A pet not listed uses right="1", left="2". Keys starting with _ are comments. This file is published with the repository and has no entries by default; a pet-facing.private.json, if present, is read as well and wins for the same pet id.
